body: Fixed in `4e75877ec`. The existing local graph-support walker skips SERVICE bodies, leaving their admission to the resolver. The new host_identity control covers remote named GRAPH, variable GRAPH with SERVICE SILENT, SERVICE within EXISTS, neighboring local GRAPH/FROM NAMED refusal, raw/prepared paths and empty/populated local carriers. It failed at runtime before the fix and passes on native and actual WASM afterward. The complete default-query corpus replay also passes with original grading and inventory. The completed delta review reports no actionable comments on the fix.
